messages:
mira: Hey folks — opened a small PR to harmonize quickstart snippets across languages. Can someone glance? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

aj: @mira looking now, thanks. Quick q: did you update the streaming example to match the new SDK API? I saw `client.stream()` vs `client.chat.stream()`

mira: Good catch — I updated Python & JS to use `client.chat.stream()` in this PR. The old `client.stream()` is removed. I left a short note in the PR description.

sam: I'll do a sweep for wording and headings in ~30m. Ping me if you need fast merge.

zack: @aj @sam also check that the snippet titles match the console landing page — we had a mismatch last week.

aj: Saw one small nit: in the JS example you have `max_tokens: 150` — our quickstarts usually use `max_tokens: 128`. Can you align for consistency?

mira: ok will change to 128. Also added a tiny fenced block for a `curl` example — lmk if that should be removed.

docs-bot: automated checks: link-checker passed, spell-check warnings: 1 (heading 'Introdution'), eslint (JS) passed.

sam: heading typo is in `quickstart.md` line ~12, I can submit a tiny follow-up or Mira can fix — up to you.

mira: I'll push the fix now.

aj: Thanks — once tests green I'm happy to approve. @mira can you squash into one commit? :+1:

mira: Squashed and pushed. Thanks all.

docs-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅

zack: Approved from me too. Feel free to merge after the 5-minute wait window.

mira: Merged — thanks team :rocket:
